findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: fx-kadar · Private data: harga, risiko, trending, kikis-web, saring-token, banding-token, tokens-baharu, imbas-kontrak · Public sink: harga, quote, risiko, peluang, trending, periksa-dompet, kikis-web, ringkas, terjemah, tulis, json, saring-token, banding-token, tokens-baharu, kikis-ringkas, sentimen, yuran-rangkaian, fx-kadar, util-kotak, yield-defi, imbas-kontrak, kadar-gas.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: fx-kadar · Private data: harga, risiko, trending, kikis-web, saring-token, banding-token, tokens-baharu, imbas-kontrak · Public sink: harga, quote, risiko, peluang, trending, periksa-dompet, kikis-web, ringkas, terjemah, tulis, json, saring-token, banding-token, tokens-baharu, kikis-ringkas, sentimen, yuran-rangkaian, fx-kadar, util-kotak, yield-defi, imbas-kontrak, kadar-gas

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
